content: The title of Section 2 in the American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines was revised to more accurately align with real-world clinical practices. Point 1a highlights the importance of adopting a structured and systematic approach to diagnostic testing for diabetes. Point 5 underscores the critical need to differentiate between various types of diabetes in order to provide tailored and individualized management strategies for patients. A newly introduced structured framework has been developed to guide the evaluation of suspected type 1 diabetes in adults who have recently been diagnosed. The diagnostic criteria for type 1 diabetes have been updated to incorporate considerations for a newly FDA-approved medication designed to delay the onset of the disease.
